messages.text: I need a new 35 mm lens for portraits. Budget up to $900.

I collected two quotes:

| Option | Shop | Price | Delivery |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lens X 35 mm f/1.8 | Shop North | $780 | 3 days |
| Lens Y 35 mm f/1.4 | Shop South | $890 | 5 days |

Lens Y is sharper wide open but heavier. Which one should I order?

replyRules.text: Lens X it is - I'll order it from Shop North and send you the confirmation.
Lens Y it is - I'll place the order with Shop South and send you the confirmation.

replies: Thanks - tell me which of the two lenses you prefer and I'll order it.
